This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]], and served as the [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the Pop-Dogs founder and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he accompanied Thaal to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] to meet Embassy-Who-Climbs, an unknown species that had appeared on the planet following some sort of fault-line slippage. Unbeknownst to the Pop-Dogs, Embassy-Who-Climbs was actually [[Turman Durra]], a member of the Galactic Alliance  [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], wearing a custom-grown [[Embass suit|suit]] while working [[Mission to Kuratooine|undercover]] to prove Thaal's criminal activities.<ref name="MK" />

In a show of friendship, Embassy-Who-Climbs presented Thaal with a crystalline box filled with gems, and Thaal reciprocated by gifting him a rolled piece of [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsi]] handed to him by his aide. Thaal explained that the flimsi was the deed to the world of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], and suggested that Embassy-Who-Climbs could reshape the world's caverns to his liking. After the meeting, Thaal and his aide were amused by the idea of falsely giving away the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="MK" />
